name: com.yamyamcoding.gameframework
description:
A modular game framework for Unity: Procedure / FSM, Entity, UI, Event, ObjectPool, ReferencePool, Sound, Scene, Setting, DataTable, Localization, Network and more.

Based on Game Framework by Jiang Yin (EllanJiang), MIT License. This edition replaces the resource pipeline with Addressables and targets Unity 6.
